verdict.rationale: Belvo documents an API that agents can drive. It covers link creation with `external_id`, asynchronous link workflows, recurrent links with webhook refresh, and retrieval of balances and transaction history, all authenticated with API keys. Belvo also markets 'Belvo MCPs' to connect AI agents, with MCP server installs for Cursor and VS Code. However, the MCP pages appear alongside the docs site, so it is unclear whether the MCP surface performs platform operations or only serves documentation. There is no evidence of scoped or least-privilege credentials for agents. Missing for 10: scoped or limited-permission API credentials for agents, documentation that the MCP tools create links and fetch balances and transactions, explicit link-management operations (update/delete), independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.
